summary: Verified AI-character media chat + regular-DM media + oversize rejection on web. 5/5 backend pytest cases pass (image-aware reply, video-aware reply, empty-send 400, DM image/video persist, DM empty 400). Frontend web verified: /messages lists AI chars, thread loads, composer renders all testids (aichar-attach, aichar-file-input, aichar-input, aichar-send), 300MB image → 'Photo too large (max 250 MB).' toast, 1.5GB video → 'Video too large (max 1 GB).' toast. Image AI reply correctly described the test photo (mentioned cat/feline features). Video AI reply via Gemini generated a non-trivial in-character response for a 574KB mp4.

minor.issue: If _media_reply raises during async delivery (e.g. media_url returns 4xx/5xx or is unreachable), the state.pending_reply_at is NEVER unset — reply_loop retries every 15s FOREVER and burns Gemini quota. Observed in logs: repeated 'Client error 403 Forbidden for url ...' every 15s. Reproduced by posting /send with media_url=https://commondatastorage.googleapis.com/gtv-videos-bucket/sample/ForBiggerBlazes.mp4 (egress-blocked here) → reply_loop looped indefinitely. Reference: /app/backend/routes/ai_characters.py:1177-1224 (_replies_once). Fix: in the except block, $unset pending_reply_at (or push it out several minutes) so it won't retry on every tick.

action_items: Harden routes/ai_characters.py::_replies_once: on exception during _media_reply (or _reply), $unset pending_reply_at or reschedule, so a bad media_url can't cause an infinite 15s retry loop.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_characters.py:1177 _replies_once — exception path doesn't clear pending_reply_at, enabling infinite retry on any media/LLM failure. HIGH impact on quota and logs.
ai_characters.py is ~1240 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into submodules (prompts, scheduling/anchors, proactive_loop, reply_loop, routes).
AiCharacterChat.jsx:88 — temp-message dedupe only compares exact text; a user who sends two identical messages while the first is pending may see one bubble disappear. Minor UX.
messages.py has no media-size validation on image_url/video_url (relies on frontend). Fine for Cloudinary URLs but should bound length.

rca of the issue: Repro: POST /api/ai-characters/{id}/send with media_url pointing to a URL that returns non-200 (e.g. 403). _media_reply raises inside _replies_once, the surrounding try/except logs the warning but never un-sets pending_reply_at. Next tick (15s later) matches the same state again → infinite loop. Mitigation: in the except branch of _replies_once, add await db.ai_char_state.update_one({'_id': state['_id']}, {'$unset': {'pending_reply_at': '', 'pending_from': ''}})  OR push it forward (set pending_reply_at = now + 5 min) with a retry counter capped at ~3.
